description: This file defines the AdvicePoint class, which models an advice point in the OpenMRS module framework including constructors, getters, and methods for managing advice point instances.

classes.name: AdvicePoint
classes.description: A class that represents an advice point within a module, including details like point name, associated class, and module.

methods.name: AdvicePoint
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing point and class instance using a class object.

methods.name: AdvicePoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AdvicePoint with a module, point name, and class name.

methods.name: getPoint
methods.description: Returns the point identifier for this advice point.

methods.name: getClassInstance
methods.description: Returns the class instance associated with this advice point, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name string associated with this advice point.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with this advice point.

methods.name: disposeClassInstance
methods.description: Resets the class instance to null, allowing it to be garbage collected or recreated.
